offline-online-gap

**Identity / target / source:** `ai:offline-online-gap` → `ai-offline-online-gap` → `src/demos/ai/ai-offline-online-gap`; source `company/domains/proposals/2026-10-18-ai-map-expansion.json#concepts/176`; brief `company/domains/briefs/2026-10-19-ai-next30f.md#5-offline-online-gap`. **Packet:** D1. **Level / prerequisites:** core; `ai:feedback-loops`.

**Nearest / distinct payoff:** feedback-loops alters exposure; this demonstrates missing logged-policy support and two indistinguishable offline worlds with opposite new-policy results.

**Computed primary model:** Four users; logger always showsA, observed rewards[1,1,0,0], mean.5. Proposed policy alwaysB. WorldGood has unobservedB rewards[1,1,1,1], WorldBad[0,0,0,0]. Identical A-only logs fit both worlds; deployingB yields1 or0. Log propensityP(B)=0, so a targetB inverse-propensity estimate is unsupported, not0.

**Countercase / boundary:** Balanced exploratory ledger includes both A/B exposures per user (8records), declared logging propensity.5 for each action; IPS estimate for targetB=sum I(actionB)*reward/.5 divided8 equals that world’s B mean. This constructed balanced ledger is additional information; it is not evidence that every finite randomized log accurately predicts future deployment or that feedback remains absent.

**Prediction / transfer recall:** Predict whether A-only data ranksB versusA uniquely; recall filling missing B rewards with0 silently selects one compatible world.

**Intervention / retained witness:** Switch hidden world holds the displayed original log fixed, then DeployB reveals distinct outcomes; Explore ledger computes actual supported estimate, retaining original Unknown/support-zero witness. No action on real users.

**Source obligation:** Declared finite construction and reproduced arithmetic support only this toy. Independently derive every visible claim; acquire an original method body with exact locator before adding generalized performance, history or empirical assertions.
